answer: The harbor schedule is applied in thread and ridge shows each instalment. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1622 impostors cost 1633 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
